input.answer:
I can't tell you whether to buy or keep renting. That is a personal financial decision, and it depends on your savings, income, job stability, how long you plan to stay in Toronto, and your own tolerance for risk. I don't give personal advice, so I won't recommend either option.

I also couldn't find a StatCan table that cleanly covers what you'd need to compare the two: Toronto resale home prices and rents together. The closest match from my search was table 18-10-0205, New housing price index, monthly. It tracks new-home prices (house and land, and house only) across census metropolitan areas, Toronto included. It does not cover resale prices, mortgage costs, or rents, so it is only a partial input. Source: https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=1810020501

For the rent side, StatCan's Canadian rent and housing data may be published elsewhere, and CMHC's Rental Market Survey is the usual source for Toronto average rents. A financial planner or mortgage adviser can help you weigh the full picture for your situation.
